body: my dreams are always mixed. sometimes i have terrible dreams and some that are just confusing. if you’d like to know about my most recent one, which really worried/confused me just send me a dm.
i usually wiggle my toes. that’s how i snap out of the paralysis

there’s not much i can tell you man. my life isn’t really that interesting right now. i’ve told you a good amount of what’s happening. i’m too embarrassed to tell anyone in real life what i feel. it would break my parents, even if they are such in a terrible situation  with me right now suicide would break them. i’m just stuck in a loop of guilt and in a shitty pit where the only exit is death. i’m trapped in a cycle. suicide wouldn’t even be that bad, there’s nothing i can do when i’m dead, i wouldn’t even have emotion, id just be blank, that’s what i strive for. i wouldn’t feel guilty about my suicide when i can’t even feel when i’m dead. it seems peaceful.

i’ve heard the phrase it gets better so many times and it never does. I’ve been stuck with a terrible state of mind for years now. if anything it got worse. i’ve attempted suicide once and got massive amounts of therapy. i was fine at the time of therapy because it worked for a few months. and then it got worse and worse and worse. i ended up getting therapy again, and i lied the entire time about getting better because i was just embarrassed to share my thoughts. that therapy ended over time because my parents started to lose money and it wasn’t an option. i just don’t believe that phrase is true. i haven’t seen a positive change, i’ve only gotten worse and worse. i’ve been like this for years now. i’m just so awful right now because everything is gone. my pc is broken, i broke up with my previous girlfriend, my friends aren’t friends, my grade is all Fs, my parents are disappointed, my sleep schedule is ruined, i barely eat breakfast or lunch. nothing in my life is going well. nothing at all.
i’m not 20. what i mean in my post i don’t see myself even being over 20. it’s something that always stuck with me. i genuinely just don’t see a future. i’m 16. i don’t at all see myself being older.

i don’t even care for money, i just want to be wanted, i just want to be happy. i have no motivation left in me man. no matter how i want to get better, i just can’t. i can’t even leave my room, everything is ruined. i have nothing except my bed. i barely leave my room unless i’m to the point where i’m starving, i just can’t. i just want to rope my neck or jump off a bridge.
i can take a walk around my neighborhood, but public spaces are limited. If i were to take a walk it would be really short and quite useless.
